description: A kfb in row 1 leaves 7 stitches. Row 2 repeats a 4-stitch rib to the last stitch after a 1-stitch edge: 5 stitches remain for the motif, which is not a whole number of repeats, so the row is an error and is not counted. Row 3 then cannot be counted either.
covers: unknown count after an uncounted row

rows.written: Row 2 (WS): p, *k2, p2; rep from * to last st, p
Row 3 (RS): k, *k2, p2; rep from * to last st, k

issues.message: row 2: the repeat over cols 2-5 cannot be worked to the end: row 1 produced 7 stitches, the rest of the row uses 2, and the 5 left are not a multiple of 4
row 3: the repeat over cols 2-5 is worked to the end of the row, but the stitch count after row 2 is unknown, so Ply cannot count this row (it needs a multiple of 4 stitches plus 2)
